metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: The question is asking if the NDVI around Windhoek, Namibia during February 2021 was higher than the 2010-2020 average for the same month. Let me break this down: 1. Location: Windhoek, Namibia (need to create a geometry) 2. Time periods: - Target: February 2021 - Baseline: February 2010-2020 (11 years of February data) 3. Data: Need NDVI data - Sentinel-2 would be good for this 4. Processing: Calculate NDVI, then compare 2021 vs 2010-2020 average 5. Potential issues: Cloud cover, data availability Strategy: 1. Create a point geometry for Windhoek, Namibia 2. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for NDVI calculation 3. For 2021: Get February 2021 images, calculate mean NDVI 4. For baseline: Get February images from 2010-2020, calculate mean NDVI for each year, then average across years 5. Compare 2021 mean NDVI vs baseline average Need to handle: - Cloud masking for Sentinel-2 - Check for empty collections - Check for valid pixels after masking - Validate results (NDVI should be between -1 and 1) Let me implement this step by step. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.0832, -22.5609]); // Windhoek, Namibia const region = windhoek.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Windhoek // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for NDVI function getFebCollection(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1); // February 1st const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 1); // March 1st (exclusive) return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } // Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // NDVI calculation function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Process a single year's February NDVI function processYearNDVI(year) { let collection = getFebCollection(year) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); const count = collection.size(); if (count.getInfo() === 0) return null; // Create mosaic and calculate mean NDVI const mosaic = collection.select('NDVI').median(); const stats = mosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNDVI = stats.get('NDVI'); const pixelCount = mosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); return { meanNDVI: meanNDVI, pixelCount: pixelCount, imageCount: count }; } // Process 2021 data const target2021 = processYearNDVI(2021); if (!target2021) { print("No 2021 February images found."); print("C1"); return; } // Process baseline years (2010-2020) const baselineYears = []; for (let year = 2010; year <= 2020; year++) { const result = processYearNDVI(year); if (result) { baselineYears.push(result); } } if (baselineYears.length === 0) { print("No baseline years (2010-2020) found."); print("C1"); return; } // Calculate baseline average const baselineMeans = ee.List(baselineYears.map(y => y.meanNDVI)); const baselineAvg = ee.List(baselineMeans).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); // Get values const targetNDVI = target2021.meanNDVI.getInfo(); const baselineNDVI = baselineAvg.getInfo(); const targetPixels = target2021.pixelCount.getInfo(); print(`2021 Feb: ${targetNDVI ? targetNDVI.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}`); print(`Baseline Avg: ${baselineNDVI ? baselineNDVI.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}`); print(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${targetPixels}`); print(`Baseline Years: ${baselineYears.length}/11`); // Validation checks if (targetPixels === 0) { print("C2"); return; } if (targetNDVI === null || baselineNDVI === null || isNaN(targetNDVI) || isNaN(baselineNDVI) || targetNDVI < -1 || targetNDVI > 1 || baselineNDVI < -1 || baselineNDVI > 1) { print("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (targetNDVI > baselineNDVI) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
